name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Slow-Cooked Beef Pot Roast & Mashed Idaho Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Braised fork-tender beef chuck simmered with carrots and savory brown gravy over fluffy mashed potatoes. Collagen is melted into a soothing, low-residue dinner.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pot Roast Dinner with mashed potatoes and brown gravy (substitute extra potatoes for kernel corn).
